items.raw_excerpt: Taiwan's National Archives Administration on Monday marked the 40th anniversary of Taipei Zoo's move on Sept. 14, 1986, by inviting the public to revisit historic photos of the move on its website.
items.summary_en: Taiwan's National Archives Administration celebrated the 40th anniversary of Taipei Zoo's relocation in 1986. The agency invited the public to view historic photos of the move on its website.
items.summary_ko: 대만 국립기록관리서가 타이베이 동물원의 1986년 이주 40주년을 맞아 기념 행사를 열었습니다. 기관은 자사 웹사이트에서 이주 당시의 역사적 사진을 공개하며 시민들의 감상을 초대했습니다.
items.title_en: Taipei Zoo marks 40 years since its big move
items.title_ko: 대만 국립기록관리서, 타이베이 동물원 이주 40주년 기념
items.title_original: Taipei Zoo's 40th relocation anniversary marked with historic photos

items.raw_excerpt: Every autumn, Munich’s Theresienwiese transforms into the site of the world’s largest folk festival. With upwards of six million visitors expected from around the globe, we’d love to hear your advice on how to make the most of the experience - or just survive.
items.summary_en: Every autumn, Munich's Theresienwiese becomes the site of the world's largest folk festival. Over six million visitors come from around the globe. The Local asks readers to share tips for making the most of the experience, or just surviving it.
items.summary_ko: 매년 가을, 뮌헨의 테레지엔비제는 세계에서 가장 큰 민속 축제가 열리는 장소가 됩니다. 전 세계에서 육백만 명 이상의 방문객이 찾아옵니다. 더 로컬은 독자들에게 이 경험을 최대한 즐기거나, 그저 버텨 내기 위한 팁을 공유해 달라고 요청합니다.
items.title_en: Tell us: your best tips for surviving Oktoberfest
items.title_ko: 말해 주세요: 옥토버페스트를 견디는 최고의 팁
items.title_original: TELL US: What are your top tips for surviving Oktoberfest?

items.raw_excerpt: With the verdict in that speaking Italian is key to life in Italy, foreign residents share their tips and tricks for mastering the language.
items.summary_en: Foreign residents in Italy share advice on mastering the Italian language. They say the key is to embrace mistakes and laugh at yourself when you get words wrong. Learning Italian helps you feel more at home in your new community.
items.summary_ko: 이탈리아에 거주하는 외국인들이 이탈리아어 익히기에 대한 조언을 공유합니다. 실수를 받아들이고 자신에게 웃음을 찾는 것이 핵심이라고 말합니다. 이탈리아어를 배우면 새로운 곳에서 더 편안한 생활을 할 수 있습니다.
items.title_en: Foreigners in Italy share their tips for learning Italian
items.title_ko: 이탈리아에 사는 외국인들의 이탈리아어 배우기 비법 공개
items.title_original: ‘Learn to laugh at yourself’: Foreigners’ advice on learning Italian

items.raw_excerpt: Great news for commuters in Oslo as public transport monthly passes in Zone 1 will see a significant price cut, falling by 160 kroner.
items.summary_en: Oslo is cutting the price of its Zone 1 monthly public transport pass by 160 kroner. The new rate is the lowest it has been in nearly 30 years. The change is good news for daily commuters in the city.
items.summary_ko: 오슬로시가 1구역 대중교통 월권 가격을 160크로네 낮춘다. 새 요금은 거의 30년 만에 가장 낮은 수준이다. 매일 대중교통을 이용하는 시민들에게 반가운 소식이다.
items.title_en: Oslo monthly transport pass drops to lowest price in 30 years
items.title_ko: 오슬로 대중교통 월권, 30년 만에 최저가로 인하
items.title_original: Oslo cuts monthly pass to lowest rate in nearly 30 years

items.raw_excerpt: From paperwork and deposits to competition and language barriers, finding a rental home in Austria can be a challenge. We want to hear from readers about their experiences.
items.summary_en: Finding a rental home in Austria can be difficult due to paperwork, deposits, competition, and language barriers. The article asks readers to share their own experiences.

items.title_en: Have your say: What is it really like to find a place to rent in Austria?

items.title_original: Have your say: What is it really like to find a place to rent in Austria?

items.raw_excerpt: The cabinet has published its plan to reform the Dutch public broadcasting system, which will replace the current 11 broadcasting organisations with four “broadcasting houses” from 2029. News broadcaster NOS and educational broadcaster NTR will also merge under the NOS name, and no new broadcasters will be allowed to join the system, media minister Rianne Letschert told parliament on Friday, NOS reported. The plan was first drawn up last year and was included in the coalition agreement and is op
items.summary_en: The Dutch government plans to replace its 11 public broadcasting organisations with four "broadcasting houses" starting in 2029. News broadcaster NOS and educational broadcaster NTR will merge under the NOS name. No new broadcasters will be allowed to join the system.
items.summary_ko: 네덜란드 정부가 현재 11개인 공영방송을 2029년부터 4개 방송국으로 줄이는 개편안을 발표했다. 뉴스 방송국 NOS와 교육 방송국 NTR은 NOS 이름 아래 합쳐진다. 앞으로 새로운 방송국의 참가는 허용되지 않는다.
items.title_en: Dutch Public Broadcasting System to Be Merged Into Four Houses by 2029
items.title_original: Public broadcasters to be merged into four “houses” from 2029

items.raw_excerpt: Portaria da Cultura palacete Celina Guinle e Linneo de Paula Machado e seus jardins. Medida foi publicada nesta segunda no Diário Oficial.
items.summary_en: The Brazilian Ministry of Culture has officially listed the Celina Guinle and Linneo de Paula Machado palace in Rio de Janeiro as protected cultural heritage. The historic palace and its gardens are now officially recognized and preserved by the government.
items.summary_ko: 브라질 문화부는 리우데자네이루에 위치한 셀리나 귀인레 및 린네오 드 파울라 마차두 궁전을 공식 문화유산으로 지정했습니다. 이 역사적 궁전과 그 정원은 이제 정부에 의해 공식적으로 인정되고 보존됩니다.
items.title_en: Historic Palace in Rio de Janeiro Gets Official Heritage Protection
items.title_ko: 리우데자네이루의 역사적 궁전이 공식 문화유산으로 지정되다
items.title_original: Ministério homologa tombamento de palacete histórico no Rio

items.raw_excerpt: Theatre producer Francesca Moody has a remarkable record of spotting shows that go on to have wide success. At the Edinburgh Fringe festival, she told NPR about what she looks for in a performance.
items.summary_en: Theatre producer Francesca Moody shared her secret to spotting successful shows at the Edinburgh Fringe festival. She told NPR that the best approach is to not actively search for a hit. Moody has a track record of discovering shows like Fleabag and Baby Reindeer.
items.summary_ko: 연극 프로듀서 프란체스카 무디가 에딘버러 프린즈 페스티벌에서 성공적인 쇼를 발견하는 비법을 공유했다. NPR과의 인터뷰에서 가장 좋은 접근법은 히트를 찾으려 하지 않는 것이라고 말했다. 무디는 플래바그와 베이비 렌디어 같은 쇼를 발견한 이력이 있다.
items.title_en: Fleabag producer's tip for finding a hit at Edinburgh Fringe? Don't look for one
items.title_ko: 플래바그 프로듀서의 에딘버러 프린즈 성공 비결? 찾으려 하지 말 것
items.title_original: The producer of Fleabag and Baby Reindeer's tip for finding a hit? Don't look for one

items.raw_excerpt: Explore Biodiseño MX at Mexico City’s Franz Mayer Museum, where biodesign brings nature, ancestral knowledge and technology together.
items.summary_en: The Franz Mayer Museum in Mexico City hosts Biodiseño MX, an exhibition that brings together biodesign, ancestral knowledge, and technology. The show explores ways of designing with living systems and non-human perspectives.
items.summary_ko: 멕시코시티의 프란츠 마이어 박물관에서 생체 디자인, 전통 지식, 기술을 하나로 엮은 'Biodiseño MX' 전시가 열리고 있다. 살아있는 시스템과 인간 중심이 아닌 관점에서 디자인하는 방법을 탐구하는 전시다.
items.title_en: Mexico City museum explores biodesign blending nature and ancestral knowledge
items.title_ko: 멕시코시티 프란츠 마이어 박물관, 자연과 전통 지식을 결합한 생체 디자인 전시
items.title_original: Biodiseño MX at the Franz Mayer Museum explores more-than-human design

items.raw_excerpt: Air quality is expected to be affected between 14 and 15 September by dust from North Africa, prompting the DGS (Directorate-General of Health) to recommend that people avoid outdoor activities and that the most vulnerable stay at home whenever possible.
items.summary_en: Dust blown from the Sahara Desert in North Africa reached Portugal on September 14 and 15. The national health authority warned residents to stay indoors and avoid outdoor activities to protect their health.
items.summary_ko: 9월 14일과 15일 북아프리카 사하라 사막에서 불어온 모래 먼지가 포르투갈에 도달했다. 국가 보건 당국은 주민들에게 실내에 머무르고 외부 활동을 피할 것을 권고했다.
items.title_en: Desert dust blows into Portugal from North Africa

items.raw_excerpt: The Letsemeng Local Municipality has acknowledged the challenges raised by residents of Luckhoff
items.summary_en: The Letsemeng Local Municipality has acknowledged concerns raised by residents of Luckhoff about high unemployment. Officials are working on plans to address the lack of job opportunities in the small Free State town.
items.summary_ko: 레트세멩 지방자치단체가 럭호프 주민들이 제기한 고실업 문제를 인정했다. 해당 프리스테이트 소재 소도시에서는 일자리 부족 해결 방안이 논의되고 있다.
items.title_en: Luckhoff residents urge Letsemeng Municipality to address unemployment
items.title_ko: 럭호프 주민, 레트세멩 지방자치단체에 실업 문제 해결 촉구
items.title_original: Residents under Letsemeng Municipality complain about unemployment

items.raw_excerpt: Klagenfurt has brought residence appointments, municipal housing applications, dog registration, and other online city services into one page. Here's how it can make your life easier.
items.summary_en: Klagenfurt has launched a new online portal that brings residence appointments, housing applications, dog registration, and other city services together in one place. Residents can now handle many administrative tasks without visiting multiple offices. The city hopes the portal will make everyday bureaucracy easier.
items.summary_ko: 클라겐푸르트 시가 거주지 예약, 공공주택 신청, 반려견 등록 등 각종 시청 서비스를 하나의 온라인 포털에 통합했습니다. 시민들은 이제 여러 창구를 오가지 않고 한 곳에서 행정 업무를 처리할 수 있게 되었습니다.
items.title_en: Klagenfurt puts city services on one new online portal

items.title_original: How Klagenfurt's new online portal could make city bureaucracy easier
